mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_alert_explanations (alert_record_id, server_id, rule_id, event_id, prompt_version, provider, model, summary, result_json, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{explanation.alertRecordId}, #{explanation.serverId}, #{explanation.ruleId}, #{explanation.eventId}, #{explanation.promptVersion}, #{explanation.provider}, #{explanation.model}, #{explanation.summary}, #{explanation.resultJson}, #{explanation.inputTokens}, #{explanation.outputTokens}, #{explanation.totalTokens}, #{explanation.durationMs}, #{explanation.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, alert_record_id, server_id, rule_id, event_id, prompt_version, provider, model, summary, result_json, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, created_at FROM ai_alert_explanations WHERE alert_record_id = #{alertRecordId}
